key.name: theme
key.description: Follow the system color scheme ("default") or force the light or dark style regardless of the OS setting.

key.name: ui-tier
key.description: "simple" shows what a game is made of — every template, the basic fields of every component — and counts the rest into a "Show N more settings" row; "full" shows every component, field, template and technical detail. A fact about the person at the keyboard: it follows them across projects and is never shared with collaborators.
